title: Anonymous tourism wednesday evening newsletter win

change.control: Monthly newsletter sent Tuesday at 8:00 a.m.

result.metric: newsletter response (reported alongside clickthrough and open rates)

sample_size.unit: emails sent across eight day/time combinations

quote: Wednesday evenings at 7 p.m. had the highest clickthrough and open rate — 16% relative difference compared to control.
notes: Second, time-of-day experiment, separate from the seven-day test. Source gives one 16% figure after mentioning both metrics without identifying a separate lift for each; retain that ambiguity rather than assigning 16% to both. No achieved significance is published. The control sent 21,746 emails and had a 4.83% open rate.
